none: No 3D model is available for your motors yet.

variantHelp.envelope: Envelope model: the motor as seen from outside - the stator with its real outer contour and the coils in its windows, rings, holders with their spoke windows, bosses, mounting holes and bolt circle, bearings, screws, the shaft with its seats and thread section, the propeller adapter, the phase board outline with notches and pins. No rotor core, magnets or inner board layers. The full model is available after the NDA is signed.
variantHelp.full: Full model: every part, with colours. Available to the owner and to accounts with a signed NDA.

sectionEnvelope: The envelope model shows the outside of the motor only, so there is nothing to cut.
measureHint: Click two points on the model
stamped: Your name and the date are written into the file name and the STEP header. Every download is logged.
contextLost: The 3D view lost its graphics context. Reload the page to continue.
